name: Model store
purpose: the box's one model store on the NVMe: /var/lib/powos/models/hf = the HF cache shared by vLLM and faster-whisper (and the VoiceAgent backend's sentence-transformers/speechbrain), torch = torch.hub (Silero VAD), vllm = vLLM's compile cache. One copy of each model; its users are voice-*, stt-batch and llm-pool
sizeMeasured: 31 GiB (2026-10-21, with llm-pool's Qwen3-14B-AWQ, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-AWQ, bge-m3)
decide: removing it re-downloads every model on the next start
